DOC. 002 — WHO IS OM SAI?

I design things that make people stop scrolling.

or at least I try to.

Om Sai is a multidisciplinary designer and creative based in Hyderabad, India, working across branding, visual identity, digital experiences, art direction, campaign design and experimental visuals.

Currently exploring the intersection of design, culture, technology, music and visual storytelling.

still figuring it out. design ≠ decoration make it memorable.

HOW I SEE DESIGN
Design should
feel something.

I like design that has a point of view. Not everything needs to be polished. Not everything needs to be symmetrical. Sometimes the weird version is the better version. I like mixing typography, photography, movement, texture and culture to create visuals that feel alive.

less decoration. more personality.break the grid.type is an image.make people look twice.
